response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior engineer, but the profile is almost entirely web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than C++. The only professional C++ exposure is roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. There is no evidence of SQL Server or Oracle depth (SQL is listed generically alongside MySQL/MongoDB), no Windows-platform specialization, and no fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain experience — RIDE Capital is retail investment fintech, not investment banking or trading systems. Strong communication, testing discipline, and open-source leadership are genuine assets, but they do not offset a mismatch on every mandatory requirement.
strengths: Broad senior-level engineering experience across many stacks and domains
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and courses
Solid engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, Docker, low-latency systems work
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No Windows-platform, SQL Server, or Oracle depth demonstrated
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment banking domain exposure
